metadata.title: HOMFLY homology for oriented tangles
metadata.abstract: We introduce an extension of Khovanov and Rozansky's categorification of the HOMFLY polynomial to arbitrary oriented tangles. Unlike previous such extensions, ours is invariant under the full suite of oriented Reidemeister moves, including the "misoriented" Reidemeister IIb. For oriented links $\mathcal{L}$, our construction recovers Khovanov and Rozansky's construction while removing the preliminary step of presenting $\mathcal{L}$ as a braid closure.
metadata.comment: 52 pages, many figures. Comments and suggestions welcome!

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 将HOMFLY多项式的Khovanov–Rozansky范畴化推广到任意有向缠结。
analysis.breakthrough: 构造覆盖全部有向Reidemeister变换，包括反向配置的IIb；对有向链环恢复原同调并省去先表示为辫闭包的步骤。
analysis.limitations: 等价与恢复结论在文中给定的有向缠结及同调范畴框架下成立。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露LLM用于图形格式处理和文字编辑，并明确说明图A.2的论证从Claude Sonnet4.6生成的例子中提取。图示用辫子同痕、闭合链上的共轭及稳定化实现一次交换移动，记录proofs及writing。此归因限定于该附录证明环节，声明没有将HOMFLY有向缠结不变量的核心构造归于模型。其余Astra候选来自a straightforward或a strand等数学英语。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.09367v1 · PDF 第6页第1.5.1节LLM Use；图A.2及对应论证在第50–51页；误命中另在第13、35、42、43页。
